name: HandleObjectScanEvent

parameters.help_en:
The target status. Valid values:

0: Unhandled.
1: Manually handled.
2: Whitelisted.
3: Ignored.
4: Access denied
parameters.help_zh:
目标状态，取值：

0: 未处理
1: 我已手动处理
2: 已加白
3: 已忽略
4: 禁止访问
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the type for batch processing of similar alerts. Valid values:

sha256: by file content
eventName: by alert name
parameters.help_zh:
批量处理同类告警，取值：

sha256：按文件内容
eventName：按告警名称
parameters.name: batch_type

fields.help_en:
The whitelist field. Valid values:

ossKey: file path
bucketName: bucket name
md5: file MD5
sha256: file SHA-256
fields.help_zh:
加白字段。取值：

ossKey: 文件路径
bucketName: Bucket名称
md5: 文件MD5
sha256: 文件SHA-256
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The operator. Valid values:

contains: Contains.
not_contains: Does not contain.
str_equal: Equals.
str_not_equal: Does not equal.
regex: Regular expression
fields.help_zh:
操作符。取值：

contains：包含
not_contains：不包含
str_equal：等于
str_not_equal：不等于
regex：正则
fields.name: operate

parameters.help_en: The list of whitelist rules. This parameter takes effect only when the alert is whitelisted
parameters.help_zh: 加白规则列表，仅当加白时有效
parameters.name: rule_condition_list

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
